transit.description: Hash-only node: re-runs check and test when a dependency's sources change.

build.description: The web bundles, the hub (kuben: bin/kuben, console embedded) and the agent (kuben-agent: bin/kuben-agent); the API module compiles.

check.description: Type checks: tsc and astro check; go vet in each Go module.

lint.description: Go static checks per module (scripts/go-check.sh: gofumpt, vet, exhaustive, go-check-sumtype, NilAway, golangci-lint). Biome is the root task biome:check.

format.description: gofumpt per Go module (Biome is the root task biome:fix).

test.description: bun test, and go test with the race detector.

gen.description: Generated code: the TS client types and the Go API server (ogen) from packages/api-client/openapi.json, the CRD types' DeepCopy (controller-gen). That spec and charts/kuben/crds/kuben.dev_all.yaml are frozen contracts: Rust generated them up to 1.2, nothing regenerates them now, and the Go tests pin the server and the embedded CRDs to them.

size.description: Size budgets: web bundle (size-limit) and the hub binary.

e2e.description: End-to-end suite against the current kube context (e.g. kind).

//#biome:check.description: Biome lint and format check over the whole repository.

//#biome:fix.description: Biome format, organize imports and safe fixes.
